item.title: A novel about the real mother of Jesus
I dreamed I made my mentor cry
item.description: In my culture, dreams are invitations, as valid as any form of knowledge transmission. After years of becoming more aware of my roots and more open to my dreamworld, I’ve learned that when dreams arrive, it’s best to pay attention.

item.title: Religious violence generational blame and other reader feedback
item.description: Religious violence I was quite taken aback by Anna Piela and Michael Woolf’s article (“The making of Islamophobia”). I want to address some of its omissions and biases regarding European history.

item.title: Verizon awards 100K to expand emergency alert network for NYC houses of worship
item.description: New York Disaster Interfaith Services, a faith-based emergency services nonprofit, has received a $100,000 grant from telecommunications company Verizon to expand its automated emergency messaging system for houses of worship across New York City.

item.title: It s not about the building
item.description: We asked experienced pastors and seminary professors to put themselves in the apostle Paul’s shoes: You’re writing a letter to a present-day ministry leader. What issues do you want to address, and what theology can you bring to bear on them? Dear Pastor, I know better than to ask how you are doing. The question feels tired.

item.title: What a society needs to survive
Amid cruelty and oppression can the church be faithful at human scale
item.description: Every so often, the levers of power in this country begin speaking a strange moral language, one impatient with persons and fluent in categories rather than faces. It speaks of order while practicing cruelty. It names enemies while erasing faces. We live in such a season now.
